about: The six genres of the link: a link is a maximally entangled pair of qudits and its genre is the pair of its end dimensions, each two, three or four by the compendium's definitions, written larger first as in the compendium's abstract. The fields split into two layers. Derived: readable, central_charge_acts, records, part and derived_extra follow from the axiom, the definitions and the read cap of the alpha Letter (d1 d2 <= 6, which it obtains from one reading of the axiom's last clause); a genre is readable when one read fixes the link. Conjectured: sector, appears and conjectured_extra, the sector of physics each genre is taken to correspond to and the particles named in its webs. Records are those of a link read twice; at (3,3), (4,3) and (4,4) the compendium gives two spellings of the closure sector (Part X), and both counts are kept. The one-dimensional end is excluded at the axiom (compendium theorem 2.9).
excluded: A one-dimensional end shares only one direction with its partner, so the pair is a product state and not entangled: excluded by the axiom (theorem 2.9).

genres.appears: the qubit pair of every hub assembly; the serial (2,2) chain is the worldline, and the frame sits at a qubit end
all five links of the photon word; the docks of the electron, the muon and the quarks; the read lines of the W and the Z
genres.conjectured_extra: its readout is α(0): the Letter's conjecture

genres.appears: the gluon word; the core triangle of the electron, muon and tau; the proton's three junction legs
the legs of every hub assembly; the adapter legs of the W and the Z
the in-leg that joins each hub assembly to its qutrit
the Higgs word, a single (4,4) pair; the hub-to-hub leg of the top and the bottom
